title.zh: 环形系统发育树与分类注释

source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 模拟树拓扑 分支长度及叶节点注释；仅复现图式，不能用于系统发育推断
provenance.en: Synthetic topology, branch lengths and leaf metadata. No original phylogenetic relationships are available.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 原始 Newick/Nexus 系统发育树：真实拓扑、枝长、根和叶节点唯一编号。
每个叶节点的 phylum、WGS/MAG/SAG 类型和样本检出情况。
检出类别的阈值和样本范围；树的末端顺序与图例计数。
en: Original Newick/Nexus phylogeny with actual topology, branch lengths, rooting and unique tip IDs.
Phylum, WGS/MAG/SAG category and sample occurrence for each tip.
Occurrence thresholds and sample scope, tip ordering and legend counts.

preprocessing.zh: 把 Newick/Nexus 转为 node/parent/length 的边表，并按 tip ID 合并注释。保留根、枝长单位与排序；此代码不做树推断。
preprocessing.en: Convert Newick/Nexus to node/parent/length edges and join tip metadata. Preserve rooting, length units and ordering; the renderer performs no phylogenetic inference.
